content: {"id":"693546cf-721e-4570-8f87-717987aeec9c","type":"https://serlo.org/editor","variant":"serlo-org","domainOrigin":"serlo.org","version":2,"editorVersion":"0.22.0","dateModified":"2025-02-26T18:27:09.103Z","document":{"plugin":"exercise","state":{"content":{"plugin":"rows","state":[{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"Stickstoffgehalt des Bodens","strong":true}]}],"id":"88bab287-39a8-4b78-a9ee-96e991c01fb7"},{"plugin":"multimedia","state":{"explanation":{"plugin":"rows","state":[{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"So findest du heraus, wie viel Stickstoff dein Boden enthält:"}]},{"children":[{"children":[{"type":"list-item-child","children":[{"text":"Besorge dir in einer Apotheke Nitrat/Nitrit-Teststreifen."}]}],"type":"list-item"},{"children":[{"type":"list-item-child","children":[{"text":"Nimm mindestens 5 Bodenproben aus 0 - 30 cm Tiefe und vermische sie gut miteinander. "}]}],"type":"list-item"},{"children":[{"type":"list-item-child","children":[{"text":"Davon füllst du etwa 1 cm hoch in ein Glas und gibst die doppelte Menge destillierten Wassers dazu."}]}],"type":"list-item"},{"children":[{"type":"list-item-child","children":[{"text":"Schüttle die Mischung einige Minuten lang, bis sich Boden und Wasser gut vermischt haben."}]}],"type":"list-item"},{"children":[{"type":"list-item-child","children":[{"text":"Warte dann, bis sich der Boden wieder abgesetzt hat."}]}],"type":"list-item"},{"children":[{"type":"list-item-child","children":[{"text":"Lege einen Teststreifen 5 Minuten lang in das Wasser und vergleiche dann die Färbung des Teststreifens mit der mitgelieferten Farbskala."}]}],"type":"list-item"},{"children":[{"type":"list-item-child","children":[{"text":"In der Lösung findest du eine Übersicht zur Beurteilung des Ergebnisses."}]}],"type":"list-item"}],"type":"unordered-list"}],"id":"7f96fb0a-6be4-461b-82e7-db6a187a3e97"}],"id":"12c09bf6-3f3f-4506-b7ee-dc60052a91c7"},"multimedia":{"plugin":"image","state":{"src":"https://assets.serlo.org/59776dca37b52_7898a7e5f803d4ad1dce5a57a656c06371ff614d.jpg","alt":"Nitrattest","caption":{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":""}]}],"id":"0c81a88d-b1a0-4290-b379-53c18ed9d41e"}},"id":"006a7297-a37d-4d7d-83a5-1e35f10f1c9b"},"illustrating":true,"width":50},"id":"01ed2854-4b9d-48f8-9cc4-2207e7c4fa20"}],"id":"036fae7c-5afe-4f8e-a24d-ca7cbe0bf3dd"},"solution":{"plugin":"solution","state":{"strategy":{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":""}]}],"id":"0b2bee22-3b2d-43e0-8a96-2f1b4a498cc0"},"steps":{"plugin":"rows","state":[{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"Bewertung der Böden nach ihrem Stickstoffgehalt "}]},{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"0     -
